response.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) as num_scans, AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as avg_gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0 GROUP BY crewref), filtered AS (SELECT num_scans, avg_gb_per_min FROM operator_stats WHERE avg_gb_per_min > (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) FROM operator_stats)) SELECT AVG(num_scans) as avg_num_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) - (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) FROM operator_stats) as avg_margin_above FROM filtered

assumptions.assumption: "The simple average of that figure across all operators" means the unweighted average of each operator's average GB-per-minute, treating all operators equally. The phrase "across all operators" indicates aggregation at the operator level (not the scan level), so each operator contributes one value to the threshold calculation regardless of their scan count.

alternatives.interpretation: If "the simple average of that figure across all operators" instead means the average of gbsize/spanmin across all valid scans (a scan-level average that weights operators by their scan count), the threshold is computed as AVG(gbsize/spanmin) over the entire scans table.
